title: Subarray Sum Equals K
summary: Count the contiguous subarrays whose sum is exactly k, when the array may contain negative numbers.

tests.explain: [1, 2] at indices 0–1, [2, 1] at 1–2, [1, 2] at 2–3 and [2, 1] at 3–4: four subarrays.
[3, 4, -7] and [4, -7, 3] both sum to 0. Negative numbers are allowed, so a window can't be used.

hints: Negative numbers break the sliding window: a sum that is too big can shrink when you add an element.
With running sums, the sum of nums[i..j] is prefix(j) - prefix(i - 1). It equals k exactly when an earlier running sum equals current - k.
Walk once, keeping a Map from running sum to how many times it has occurred (start with 0 → 1). At each step add map.get(sum - k) to the answer, then record sum.

complexity.time: O(n): one pass with O(1) map operations
complexity.space: O(n): up to n distinct running sums
